name: epoch_operator_model_tool_harness
summary: Operator-selected model plus bounded Epoch-owned project and engine tools. No internal model, model training, hidden watcher, or autonomous source write-through exists.

loop.input: operator request plus active project and evidence
validated call plus required operator approval
loop.output: one tool result and evidence attachments

loop.input: tool results, tests, captures, diagnostics, and diffs
loop.output: pass, fail, cancellation, or blocked evidence

policy: Never allow blind repo write-through from planner or executor output.
Normal chat is not automatically captured or treated as training data.
Every write, child process, engine-source edit, and network-sensitive action requires the declared capability and visible approval.
No model may commit, push, release, start a listener, or grant itself permission.
Tool completion requires structured result and evidence, not model confidence.
